message.reasoning:
With my light blues monopoly I could put 3 houses on each for $450, leaving only $11 in cash, which feels risky given opponents' stronger properties—I'd have unmortgaged assets to fall back on if needed, but I'm weighing whether to build fewer houses instead.

Actually, looking at the rent jumps, going from 2 to 3 houses roughly triples the rent, and since both opponents are cash poor (170 and 324), building 3 houses each likely bankrupts one of them on a hit. I have plenty of mortgage buffer across my other properties (roughly 700 available), so I'll commit to building 3 houses on each light blue.
